scenes.line: Welcome to planet Maya, Captain. I'm Sergeant Wilhelm of Merchant Corp.
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Locked physical medium shot. Hands on desk. Warm professional greeting.

scenes.line: I know you're coming to our planet for the first time, and your skills will come in handy.
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Continue same camera, attentive composed face. No reset or new gesture.

scenes.line: Here at Merchant Corp, we gather resources like lumber, oil, and other rare resources, then sell them to people on other planets.
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Same physical speaker, modest explanatory gesture, remains seated.

scenes.line: However, it's getting harder to find these resources. That's why we need you to help us.
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Focused serious eye contact. End with glance toward wall map.

scenes.line: We've just found Fortuna. No team has explored it.
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Wilhelm points to the wall map. Camera pushes toward crescent coast. Hand leaves frame before map fills picture.

scenes.line: It's far from our main base. It may have oil, gold, and useful wood. But storms and wild animals may make the trip dangerous.
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm VO

scenes.line: Explore Fortuna and report what you find. If the resources are there and the site is safe, we'll ask you to build a base and start collecting them.
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Physical Wilhelm beside map looks back toward captain, authoritative but fair. Same room geometry.

scenes.line: You'll lead your own crew, build your own base, and get ten percent of the profit after costs. That's the money left after costs. Will you take the mission?
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Locked desk medium shot. Wilhelm is already seated and remains seated throughout. Speak the offer ONCE with no repetition. Inviting firm offer with restrained expressions. No stand/sit movement or large gestures. Finish closed mouth hands resting at same waiting anchor. NO captain gesture.

scenes.line: You want more? All right. Fifteen percent. Do we have a deal?
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Small thoughtful concession, controlled slight disappointment. Ends at closed mouth hands resting anchor.

scenes.line: Again? Twenty percent. That's my final offer.
scenes.speaker: Wilhelm
scenes.action: Locked seated desk shot. A brief dry exasperated sigh WITHOUT speech, then exact final offer. Only these words are spoken: Again? Twenty percent. That's my final offer. Never say his name or other words. Do not read prompt directions. Remain seated hands resting, ends identical closed-mouth waiting anchor.
Locked silent breathing loop, same closed mouth and hands resting at both endpoints. No music or speech.

scenes.action: Same cockpit. Dangerous rain and rapid approaching storm. No happy smile, grinning, cheerful delivery, flirting or playful relief at ANY frame. Treat this as a crew safety warning, not cheerful tour guide. The right engine immediately catches a sustained small orange fire with continuous black smoke. Right propeller stops.
